caseStudies.title: Moving billions of messages from MongoDB to Cassandra
caseStudies.description: How Discord escaped MongoDB tail-latency degradation by rethinking their message data model around Cassandra partition semantics.

caseStudies.title: From fanout-on-write to hybrid delivery
caseStudies.description: How Twitter's news feed moved away from pre-computing timelines for all followers as accounts reached millions of followers.

caseStudies.title: The BGP leak that took down Cloudflare
caseStudies.description: How a single misconfigured route advertisement propagated globally and what Cloudflare changed about their route filtering and BGP safety nets.

caseStudies.title: The Slack message storm incident
caseStudies.description: How a feedback loop between presence updates and reconnecting clients took down Slack and what changes in their notification and connection handling prevented recurrence.

caseStudies.title: Building resilience with Chaos Monkey
caseStudies.description: How Netflix made reliability a continuous practice by deliberately injecting failures into production, and what this revealed about their dependency assumptions.

caseStudies.title: The Pods architecture: sharding by tenant
caseStudies.description: How Shopify decomposed a single Rails monolith into isolated per-merchant shards to achieve independent failure domains and predictable tenant resource limits.

caseStudies.title: Sharding GitHub's MySQL infrastructure
caseStudies.description: How GitHub moved from a single MySQL primary to a sharded topology to handle write throughput at scale while keeping query patterns compatible.

caseStudies.title: Jeff Bezos's API mandate and the SOA migration
caseStudies.description: How Amazon's internal mandate that all teams expose data only through service interfaces reshaped their monolith into an ecosystem of independent services.
